quotes.text: Shadow it isn't a rebellion, but a response to a bottleneck created by the system itself. People aren't trying to be malicious, they are just trying to do their jobs and deliver results for the company.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes shadow IT as a symptom of slow governance rather than user misconduct.

quotes.text: We have to stop trying to fix the default environment and start bypassing it. The solution isn't a better cleanup crew. It's a better architectural starting point.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear architectural recommendation for escaping the Power Platform default environment.

quotes.text: We need to stop thinking about data loss prevention or DLP as a no machine. It's a contextual filter. It is the intelligence that lives inside the architecture.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concisely redefines the purpose of DLP policies from blocking to contextual guardrails.

quotes.text: Real-time feedback beats a post-build audit every single time. With automated guardrails, the maker is notified the moment they try to drag a non-compliant connector onto the canvas.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why automated guardrails work better than after-the-fact reviews.

quotes.text: A real COE isn't a committee. It is a capability. It is the intelligence layer that sits directly on top of your automated guard rails.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable definition of what a Center of Excellence should be.

takeaways: Saying no to makers does not remove risk; it pushes work into shadow IT and removes the visibility IT wanted to protect.
Environment routing into personal developer environments and DLP connector classification replace manual ticket gates with automated guardrails.
A Center of Excellence that acts as a capability, not a committee, uses the CoE Starter Kit and maker recognition to bring shadow solutions into governed paths.
hook: Manual, ticket-based governance cannot keep up with thousands of low-code apps, so makers move into the shadows. This episode shows Power Platform admins and IT leaders how environment routing, automated DLP guardrails and a modern Center of Excellence let speed and security coexist.
